subject: Contract synchrony checklist for eval handshake
messages:
From: Kate Foster <kate.foster@novalign.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@novalign.com>, legal@novalign.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Eval windows & contract handoff — need sequencing

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — folks on our side liked the latency profile and the quantization roadmap. We're mobilizing procurement and legal to run an expedited evaluation and signature cycle. Two asks from procurement/legal: 

1) Can you send a minimal mutual action plan (MAP) that maps evaluation milestones to the MSA/DPA/order form gating events? Procurement needs explicit dates for acceptance testing, evidence delivery, and expected signature windows so we can staff reviewers.

2) We have a cyclical audit next month; our legal team wants to confirm the SOC2 artifacts that Redwood will provide during the evaluation window (even if redacted). If you can include a stub list or placeholder, that helps speed review.

Goal: 30–45 day onramp from kickoff to signature if both sides keep to review SLAs. Do you have a suggested timeline? We can be flexible on the order form shape if the MSA and DPA are agreed first.

Appreciate a quick draft today — procurement is blocking internal scheduling until we see a concrete plan.

Best,
Kate Foster
Senior Procurement Manager
Novalign Health

---
Attachments: none referenced in this message
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: Kate Foster <kate.foster@novalign.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@novalign.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval windows & contract handoff — need sequencing

Kate — thanks for the clear asks. I'm attaching a lightweight MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) that aligns evaluation checkpoints to contract artifacts and sign-off owners. Highlights below: 

- Week 0 (kickoff): Security questionnaire in progress, legal kickoff call.
- Week 1–2: Pilot evaluation (feature + perf), Redwood provides SOC2 evidence stub and shared drive link.
- Week 3: Joint acceptance run (customer acceptance tests + evidence confirmation).
- Week 4: MSA/DPA redline window (Novalign legal + Redwood legal).
- Week 5: Order form finalization and signature window (contingent on redline turnaround).

I think the 30–45 day target is feasible if both legal teams adhere to 5 business day review cycles. Per your note, we can split execution: agree MSA/DPA first, then parallelize order form pricing and SOW prep.

I've cc'd Laura (sales ops) and Karthik (legal operations) to coordinate evidence handoff and to flag any standard terms we should pre-clear. Laura — can you confirm the onboarding SLA and acceptance criteria bullet list in the MAP? Karthik — please confirm if Redwood can pre-approve the standard data residency clause for Novalign's region to shorten legal review.

I'll upload the MAP to our shared drive and include the SOC2 stub PDF for your review. If that looks good, we can set a short alignment call this afternoon (20 min) to lock dates.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-Evidence-Stub.pdf
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed sequencing and quick checklist for Novalign (please review)

Laura / Karthik — looping you both for rapid triage. Below is a concise checklist to reduce back-and-forth with Novalign legal/procurement. Please reply with red/high flags by 14:00 PT.

1) Evidence handoff (owner: Laura): post SOC2 stub link in Drive, confirm log retention window and contact for audit copies. Deliverable: SOC2-Evidence-Stub.pdf + access request template.
2) MSA redline template (owner: Karthik): pre-populate the standard Redwood compromise (data residency + liability cap) we can offer for mid-market healthcare customers. If any clause requires exec approval, flag now.
3) DPA addendum (owner: Karthik): confirm that our standard DPA (with subprocessors list) is acceptable; if Novalign needs a specific subprocessor SLA, escalation to privacy team might add time.
4) Order form (owner: Laura): pricing and SKU lock; suggest parallelizing final pricing while legal redlines MSA/DPA to hit signature in week 5.
5) Acceptance criteria (owner: Michael): fill acceptance test plan in MAP; make explicit pass/fail thresholds and sample prompts/datasets for the pilot.

Notes: 
- If Novalign requests additional security evidence beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test reports), warn procurement it will extend timeline by ~2 weeks.
- Offer: we can provide a 30-day startup credit if they commit to the 45-day cadence and sign by a target date. Do we have margin approval for that, Laura?

Karthik — can you confirm whether a one-off liability carveout needs legal director approval or if you can sign off? If it's required, include an estimated 7–10 business day SLA in the MAP.

Please keep replies short — procurement is waiting. If you prefer, I'll take the first 1:1 with Novalign to walk through MAP items.

Thanks — Michael

---
Internal-only checklist; no attachments in this internal note
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: Kate Foster <kate.foster@novalign.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@novalign.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Contract synchrony checklist for eval handshake — proposed timeline

Kate / Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround. Attached is the MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short order form template (OrderForm-Template.docx). Below is the proposed, actionable timeline — conservative and optimistic lanes included so procurement can pick a cadence: 

Conservative (no surprises):
- Day 0: Kickoff — security questionnaire shared, legal kickoff call scheduled.
- Days 1–10: Pilot evaluation + SOC2 stub + acceptance test execution (customer provides test dataset).
- Days 11–18: Legal review window for MSA/DPA (one round).
- Days 19–24: Order form finalize and internal approvals.
- Day 25–30: Signatures executed.

Optimistic (fast-track):
- Day 0: Kickoff.
- Days 1–7: Pilot evaluation + evidence handoff.
- Days 8–12: Parallel MSA/DPA review (tight 3–5 business day cycles) + order form drafting.
- Day 13–18: Final sign.

Acceptance criteria summary (from MAP):
- Performance: 95th percentile < 120 ms for standard eval prompt set.
- Quality: no more than 3% regression on the provided evaluation prompts compared to baseline.
- Evidence: SOC2 stub + access to audit log snapshot (redacted) and data flow diagram.

Risk flags to watch: additional security requests (pen tests, on-prem trials), liability carveouts, and unusual SCC/residency demands. Each of those adds 7–14 days depending on scope.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm target lane (conservative vs. optimistic) and the primary legal reviewer for Novalign.
2) If optimistic, confirm that Novalign legal can commit to 3–5 business day turnarounds for up to two rounds.
3) Sign the MAP as a shared working artifact in Drive and we will update it in real time.

I'll host a 20-minute alignment call at 17:00 PT if you'd like to run the MAP live — happy to shorten that to 10 minutes for execs.

Best regards,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, OrderForm-Template.docx
